# NONSTOP PRIVATE

> NONSTOP PRIVATE is a luxury concierge and lifestyle management service. One message is all it takes: a single dedicated contact arranges villas, yachts, private jets, chauffeurs, restaurant and nightclub tables, events and experiences, in Dubai, Mykonos, Courchevel, the French Riviera (Saint-Tropez, Monaco, Cannes), Ibiza and worldwide. Requests are answered by a person, 24/7, with a free personalised quote; nothing is booked until the client approves it.

Key facts:
- Name: NONSTOP PRIVATE
- Type: luxury concierge, private lifestyle management, VIP bookings
- Main destinations: Dubai, Mykonos, Courchevel, Saint-Tropez, Monaco, Cannes, Ibiza; also Paris, London, Marbella, Miami, St Barth, Bali and other destinations through trusted partners
- Services: luxury villa and chalet rental, luxury hotels, yacht charter, private aviation, private chauffeur and security, restaurant reservations, nightclub and beach club tables, events (Formula 1 Grand Prix, New Year's Eve, Cannes Film Festival), experiences, shopping and gifts
- Clients can send a single request or join the yearly membership (dedicated lifestyle manager, priority access)
- Contact: contact@nonstop-private.com, +33 7 66 90 99 71 (phone and WhatsApp), https://nonstop-private.com/contact.html
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/np_private_worldwide/
- Languages: English and French (French pages under /fr/)
